paragraphs: 247Security sells video recording systems for vehicle fleets, and school bus video is the product it puts at the front of its site. Its school bus offering pairs on-vehicle cameras with cloud fleet management software. Public transit and motor coach operators are a second market listed on the site.

Video comes off the vehicle wirelessly over cellular or wi-fi rather than by pulling hard drives, and is retrieved from cloud servers. Staff can watch a bus live over a cellular link while recording continues uninterrupted. The lineup also includes a compact sensor that detects smoking and vaping devices on board. The company says its storage device carries a lifetime warranty and keeps recorded video encrypted.

Products are designed, assembled and packaged in Canada and the United States. Installation is handled by the company's own teams, which it says work on more than 3000 buses a year. Feature decisions draw on transportation directors, shop leaders and mechanics, according to the about page. Support is pitched around reaching a person on the phone rather than a call centre.
